summary: Implemented grid-sampled patch iteration. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch yields (patch, coordinates) pairs; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; PatchDataset example uses float), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry), and new tests/test_grid_dataset.py (TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape, test_loading_array, and an extra test_missing_len). Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests are unverified. Assumption: test_loading_array uses np.arange(16) reshaped to (1,4,4) for both images, the only input I found consistent with the pinned values. The two-worker pinned values are taken as given and are the most likely to fail. Three pre-existing lines over 120 characters remain in utils.py (get_valid_patch_size docstring). No commits were made.
